title: 4% Paraformaldehyde in 0.1M PB preparation
author: Monique Copeland
materials: Top off to 500ml with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Prepare dibasic phosphate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve sodium phosphate dibasic dihydrate (Fisher Scientific Catalog #S472-500) to make a 1 M stock solution; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare monobasic phosphate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve sodium phosphate monobasic anhydrous (Fisher BioReagent Catalog #BP329-500) to make a 1 M stock solution; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Make 1 M phosphate buffer pH 7.4
steps.instruction: Combine 19 mL of the 1 M monobasic stock with 81 mL of the 1 M dibasic stock to obtain 100 mL of 1 M phosphate buffer at pH 7.4.

steps.title: Add water to beaker
steps.instruction: Add 400 mL of Milli‑Q water to a 1000 mL beaker (Milli‑Q® Integral Water Purification System, Millipore Sigma, Catalog #ZRXQ010WW).

steps.title: Add stir bar and heat
steps.instruction: Place a magnetic stir bar in the beaker and set the hot plate to 50 °C.

steps.title: Add NaOH to aid dissolution
steps.instruction: Add 5 drops (≈500 µL) of 10 N NaOH (Thomas Scientific Catalog #C871W32) to the water; this makes the solution basic to help dissolve paraformaldehyde.

steps.title: Dissolve paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Weigh 20 g of paraformaldehyde (Catalog #19200) and add it to the beaker; stir for about 1 hour (01:00:00) or until the solution is clear and all paraformaldehyde is dissolved.

steps.title: Add phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of the 1 M phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) prepared above to the paraformaldehyde solution.

steps.title: Adjust final pH
steps.instruction: Measure the pH of the mixture and adjust to the desired final pH using HCl or additional NaOH as needed.

steps.title: Filter the solution
steps.instruction: Filter the final solution through a 0.2 µm cellulose acetate vacuum filter (Corning™ Disposable Vacuum Filter/Storage System, Fisher Scientific Catalog #09-761-5).

steps.title: Label and store
steps.instruction: Label the container ‘4 % paraformaldehyde in 0.1 M PB’ with the date. Store at 4 °C for up to 1 week. Optionally aliquot 50 mL portions into Falcon tubes and store at –20 °C for up to 3 months.
